items.title: Albert "June" Gardner Interview, 1996-04-17
items.q: he didn't know I was there with Wallace Dembo, as a matter of fact.

ctx.x: You know. But I didn't recall it.

When we went and when I ran across him in Montrose, Switzerland, he didn't know I was there with Wallace Dembo, as a matter of fact. Oh, okay. With Wallace. And when he tamed me, he started crying because he wanted to hire me to play with him. But, you know, Pirelli, what's his name, Pirelli? What? The drummer, I can't call his name, Pirelli Pirelli. Bernard Pirelli. Bernard Pirelli. Bernard Pirelli. Was playing with him. Oh, Bernard, okay. Yeah. You know, but he wanted me, he didn't know I was going to be over…
You're going to do that, yeah. Someday tell me and we'll do a look at photographs or something.
